factcheck.claim: Claude Pro is $20/month monthly in the US, discounting to roughly $17/month ($200 upfront) on annual billing in 2026 — the only tool among the shortlisted eight with a meaningful annual discount on the entry plan.
ChatGPT Plus lists at $20/month flat in 2026 with no annual discount — unchanged since February 2023 per three independent 2026 reviews, and confirmed on the openai.com/chatgpt/pricing page.
Jasper Creator plan costs $49/month on monthly billing or $39/month on annual billing in 2026 — the entry plan for individual bloggers, including Jasper Chat, SEO mode, and 1 Brand Voice.

Surfer SEO Essential plan is $99/month on monthly billing or $79/month on annual billing ($948/year) in 2026, including 30 Content Editor articles, 5 AI articles, 100 page audits, and unlimited keyword research — with each extra AI article costing $29.

KoalaWriter's Essentials plan starts at $9/month with 15,000 words, scaling up through Starter $29/mo (45,000 words), Professional $59/mo (100,000 words), Growth $119/mo (250,000 words), and Business $249/mo (500,000 words) — plus 5,000-word free trial without a credit card.

Frase restructured its pricing in 2026 — the old Solo $14.99 / Basic $44.99 / Team $114.99 plans have been replaced with Starter $49, Professional $129, and Scale $299, with Unlimited AI writing as a $35/month add-on.

ChatGPT Plus defaults to a 'helpful assistant' voice — enthusiastic opener phrases, occasional 'as an AI language model' leakage, softer stakes-free framing — while Claude Pro hedges more with qualifiers ('typically', 'in most cases') and produces more natural long-form prose, per the 2026 reviewer consensus across undetectedgpt, christopheralarcon, and tminusai.

Claude's free tier gives roughly 30–40 messages per 5-hour rolling window on the latest model in 2026, and ChatGPT's free tier gives roughly 10 GPT-5 messages per 5 hours with ad-supported access in the US — enough for one to two medium-length blog drafts per session but not for long iteration, per the undetectedgpt and foraithings 2026 reviews cross-checked with OpenAI's public tier documentation.

Grammarly Premium lists at $30/month on monthly billing in 2026, discounting to roughly $12/month ($144/year) on annual billing — the voice-polish layer most 2026 blogger stacks pair with Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus.
Scalenut Essential is listed at $37/month in 2026, bundling SEO brief creation, AI drafting, and ranking tracking into a single content-lifecycle workflow aimed at agency content teams.

KoalaWriter is one of the few one-click AI blog writers that reliably beats a Claude-Pro-plus-a-brief workflow on time-per-post once voice presets and keyword workflows are configured, per the eesel.ai and dailyaireviews 2026 reviews.
